name: Marsh McLennan (ex-MMC; NYSE ticker changed 2026-01-14, CIK 0000062709, IBKR conid 9705)
verdict: WATCH 4/10 (court 2026-08-02; sourcing 9 vacated). Thrive VERIFIED as the only filed quantified cost program in the universe ($400M annualized savings / $500M cost / 3yr, FY25 10-K acc 0000062709-26-000022 + Q2-26 10-Q -000195) - but the AI attribution is REFUTED (filed language is generic 'process and automation efficiencies and optimization of our global operating model'; AI appears in MRSH's risk factors as a THREAT), and 4 program-quarters in the savings are showing NOWHERE they must: adjusted op margin (which excludes Thrive charges, so realized savings flow straight through) fell 20bp YoY in Q2 AND H1; comp ratio Q2 +8bp WORSE YoY; zero realized-savings dollars disclosed; program spend decelerating ~55% from launch pace; headcount RISING +12%/2y (McGriff) with RIS comp ratio worsening 54.7->56.3%. D3 retention UNVERIFIED: commission/fee split undisclosed; filed risk language = commission-rate compression + disintermediation; commission-on-premium revenue means the softening P&C cycle deflates the revenue unit the savings are measured against. D6 ADVERSE on three lines each of scale vs the 1.48pt-of-revenue program: Greensill ($425M Q1-26 charge alone > the whole program's annualized target; remaining claims ~$2-5B; TRIAL SEPTEMBER 2026 = dated binary inside the pre-print window), fiduciary interest income decay (-$94M FY25; 100bp of cuts ~ $122M/yr ~ 31% of program savings on $12.2B fiduciary cash), P&C softening filed 3x with Guy Carpenter -2% underlying. At 23.4x TTM GAAP / 18.8x TTM adjusted the tape pays fair-compounder price with the AI-adopter edge ABSENT from the prints. Filings are notably honest - no takeaway-divergence flag on MRSH itself; the divergence risk is in anyone marketing this as an AI-margin story.

Retention premise remains UNPROVEN - now with the direction of filed evidence AGAINST it.
